result_summary.title: SSO Lockouts and Audit Gaps - We are sure this is a firewall misconfiguration
result_summary.description: We are seeing a high volume of account lockouts for our users in the LATAM region. Additionally, the audit logs are missing entries for these events and we are getting certificate warnings when trying to establish connections. 871 users are currently blocked. We have checked the internal services and everything looks fine on that side. This is definitely a firewall misconfiguration blocking the traffic or modifying the headers incorrectly. Please investigate the network edge immediately.
